restaurant_name: Diamond Optic Professional Optical Center Chiang Mai
text:
This shop was recommended to me, and when I was staying in Chiang Mai the other month, I decided to go there because my glasses were in pretty rough shape. The employees and optometrist at Diamond Optic were truly wonderful. They spent lots of time with me to make sure my prescription was correct. They even found the reason why I had been having so much trouble with my older glasses, and made sure that the pupilary distance-- the issue with the older pair-- was good with the new glasses.

I ended up having to leave Chiang Mai sooner than expected, and I was able to have Diamond Optic ship me my new glasses all the way to California. Customer service is top-notch, and the exams are really thorough. I can't recommend this place enough. Even if it's a bit out of your way, definitely go here!
